title: Tech Note: My First Web Grid
author: Add Komoncharoensiri

historical_commentary.text: This note documents the 4D Ajax Framework's Data Grid 2.0 component, a cornerstone of 4D's early-2000s web strategy for displaying tabular data with Web 2.0 AJAX/JavaScript interaction. The framework provided pre-built CSS themes, localization support, and JavaScript constructors for customizing grid appearance and behavior inline. As a practical guide to integrating AJAX data grids into custom HTML pages, the note showcases the framework's then-modern approach to dynamic web UIs. However, the 4DAF/A4D framework has been entirely superseded by 4D's modern REST-based architecture, web components, and Qodly (4D's low-code platform from 2023+), rendering both the specific tooling and architectural patterns described here obsolete.
related_updates: 4D Ajax Framework and 4DAF/A4D have been fully discontinued and replaced by REST APIs
Modern 4D web development uses web components, Vue.js integration, and Qodly instead of AJAX grids
Localization, styling, and data binding are now handled via ORDA and client-side frameworks
CSS theme system and JavaScript API for grids no longer exist in current 4D product lines
